basis: The alternative point query eliminates false floor contacts but changes remaining wall depth; not admitted as a drop-in reward replacement.
scope: Original signed-distance query + mathematically conservative world-AABB translational penetration upper bound veto only. Original report code/default threshold1mm unchanged; original floor tolerance5cm unchanged.
allowed_change: Discard raw geometry pairs ONLY if an outward-rounded upper bound on true translational penetration is strictly less than the original1mm report threshold. Do not cap or replace other distances. Unsupported bounds retain original pair and mark unknown.
